guesses.breed: Domestic Shorthair (brown tabby and white / bicolor)
guesses.reason: Short dense coat, mostly white body with a brown tabby cap over the head and ears, a tabby patch on the back, and a dark ringed tabby tail are classic random-bred bicolor markings.
White dominates the body, with color concentrated on the head cap and tail plus a small back patch, approaching a van-like distribution.
Color restricted largely to the head and tail on a white body loosely resembles the Turkish Van pattern, though the coat is too short and plush to suggest much Van ancestry.

breed.appearance: A medium-sized, sturdy shorthaired cat with a mostly white coat, a brown-gray tabby 'cap' across the top of the head and around both ears, a gray tabby patch on the left shoulder and back, and a dark charcoal-and-brown ringed tabby tail curled around the front paws. The face is mostly white with a soft rounded muzzle, a pink nose, and an inverted-V white blaze rising between the eyes into the tabby cap, framing large round green-gold eyes. Her ears are medium-large and upright with pinkish insides, her chest is fluffy and white, and she sits upright with a calm, slightly curious expression.
breed.fun_fact: Bicolor tabby-and-white Domestic Shorthairs like Gaby are known for their hardy health and easygoing, adaptable personalities, making them wonderful companions for almost any home!
